hero.subtitle: Student developer studying Computer Science, Mathematics, and Physics at A-Level. Currently building a database engine with its own SQL dialect.

about.title: About
about.lede: I like building things from the ground up.
about.intro: I'm based in Manchester, studying Computer Science, Mathematics, and Physics. My main project is MonoDB, a database engine with its own SQL dialect, built for my A-Level coursework. Alongside it I make web apps and command-line tools.

packagemanager.title: PackageManager
packagemanager.description: A lightweight command-line package manager written in Go. Installs .tar.gz packages with a single command.

busesinfo.title: Buses Info
busesinfo.description: A web app that shows college bus times and bay information at a glance, replacing a slower, harder-to-read system.

nea.title: MonoDB
nea.description: A database engine with its own SQL dialect and a management interface. Supports SQL, document, and key-value tables, with query optimisation and transactions. Built as my A-Level coursework project.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Open to interesting projects and opportunities. Email is the fastest way to reach me.
